description: This file implements default and configurable time domain allocations for PDSCH in 5G NR, including functions to retrieve specific allocations based on various configurations and search space types.

methods.name: s_and_len
methods.description: Helper function to construct ofdm_symbol_range with start and length.

methods.name: pdsch_default_time_allocations_default_A_table
methods.description: Returns default PDSCH time domain resource allocations based on cyclic prefix and DMRS position.

methods.name: pdsch_default_time_allocation_default_A_get
methods.description: Retrieves a specific default allocation row based on index, cyclic prefix, and DMRS position.

methods.name: get_c_rnti_pdsch_time_domain_list
methods.description: Gets PDSCH time domain list for C-RNTI based on search space and BWP configurations.

methods.name: get_si_rnti_pdsch_time_domain_list
methods.description: Gets PDSCH time domain list for SI-RNTI based on cyclic prefix and DMRS position.

methods.name: get_si_rnti_type0A_common_pdsch_time_domain_list
methods.description: Gets PDSCH time domain list for SI-RNTI Type0A common, with fallback to default table.

methods.name: get_ra_rnti_pdsch_time_domain_list
methods.description: Gets PDSCH time domain list for RA-RNTI, with fallback to default table.
